simplicity-r1-f1.rationale: AI's defence held. The chat-line summary contract IS one cross-cutting emit-on-exit rule with a single AC verification surface (AC-15 verifying goal Outcome (c)+(d) directly per PRD line 135) — folding it into seven per-task acceptances would split the verification across seven tasks and lose the cross-cutting contract surface. The 002-develop-skill Gate 3 simplicity-r1-f1 precedent (T5/T5b kept distinct) bites in the same direction here: simplicity at the task layer cannot override traceability anchored in a load-bearing cross-cutting contract. Goal-Driven's goal-r1-f1 acceptance just sharpened T15's coverage-matrix row to make the goal-anchoring explicit; dropping T15 would unwind that resolution. The seven-task dependency-list is not over-decomposition — it is the surface AC-15 verifies. Principle bites on bookkeeping that adds no shippable surface; releases on cross-cutting contracts with a single-AC verification.
